```{r}


# Function to plot attention density over tokens
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)

# Function to plot attention density over tokens
plot_attention_density <- function(df, row_idx = 5) {
  # Extract data for the specified row
  layer <- df$layer[row_idx]
  head <- df$head[row_idx]
  
  # Parse the attention_scores string into a numeric vector
  scores_str <- df$attention_scores[row_idx]
  # Remove newlines and convert spaces to commas for JSON parsing
  scores_str <- gsub("\n", "", scores_str)
  scores_str <- gsub(" ", ", ", scores_str) # rm extra spaces
  scores_str <- gsub(", ,", ",", scores_str) # rm extra commas
  scores_str <- gsub(", ,", ",", scores_str) # rm extra commas again
  scores <- fromJSON(scores_str)
  
  # Parse the tokenized_passage string into a vector of tokens
  token_str <- df$tokenized_passage[row_idx]
  # Remove the brackets and split by comma+space, then clean quotes
  token_str <- gsub("^\\[|\\]$", "", token_str)  # Remove outer brackets
  tokens <- strsplit(token_str, ", ")[[1]]  # Split by comma+space
  tokens <- gsub("^'|'$", "", tokens)  # Remove surrounding quotes
  
  # Create a dataframe for plotting
  plot_df <- data.frame(
    token = tokens,
    position = 1:length(tokens),
    attention = scores[1:length(tokens)]
  )
  
  # Create the plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = position, y = 1, fill = attention)) +
    geom_tile(height = 1) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "white", 
      mid = "lightblue", 
      high = "darkblue",
      midpoint = median(plot_df$attention),
      name = "Attention\nScore"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = plot_df$position,
      labels = plot_df$token
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Attention Scores - Layer", layer, "Head", head),
      x = "Tokens",
      y = ""
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Example usage:
# plot_attention_density(df_tmp, row_idx = 1000)

# To plot multiple rows (e.g., different layers/heads):
plot_multiple_attention <- function(df, indices = 1:min(4, nrow(df))) {
  plots <- lapply(indices, function(i) {
    plot_attention_density(df, i)
  })
  
  # Combine plots using patchwork (if installed)
  if (require(patchwork)) {
    return(wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 1))
  } else {
    return(plots)  # Return list of plots
  }
}
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(jsonlite)

plot_attention_density <- function(data, row_idx) {
  # Get the row
  row_data <- data[row_idx, ]
  
  # Parse tokenized_passage - it's in Python list format
  tokens_str <- row_data$tokenized_passage
  tokens_str <- gsub("^\\[|\\]$", "", tokens_str)  # Remove outer brackets
  
  # Split by comma, but only when outside quotes
  # Use a regex to match quoted strings
  tokens <- regmatches(tokens_str, gregexpr("'[^']*'", tokens_str))[[1]]
  tokens <- gsub("'", "", tokens)  # Remove the quotes
  
  # Clean tokens - remove 'Ġ' symbol (represents space in tokenizers)
  tokens <- gsub("Ġ", "", tokens)
  
  # Parse attention_scores - convert directly to numeric
  scores_str <- row_data$attention_scores
  scores_str <- gsub("^\\[|\\]$", "", scores_str)  # Remove outer brackets
  scores <- as.numeric(strsplit(trimws(scores_str), "\\s+")[[1]])
  
  # Debug: print lengths to verify they match
  cat("Number of tokens:", length(tokens), "\n")
  cat("Number of scores:", length(scores), "\n")
  
  # Handle length mismatch
  min_len <- min(length(tokens), length(scores))
  if (length(tokens) != length(scores)) {
    warning(paste("Length mismatch! Tokens:", length(tokens), 
                  "Scores:", length(scores), 
                  "Using first", min_len, "elements"))
    tokens <- tokens[1:min_len]
    scores <- scores[1:min_len]
  }
  
  # Create dataframe for plotting
  plot_df <- data.frame(
    token = tokens,
    position = 1:length(tokens),
    attention = scores
  )
  
  # Extract model, layer, and head info
  model_name <- row_data$model_shorthand
  layer <- row_data$layer
  head <- row_data$head
  
  # Create heatmap
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = position, y = 1, fill = attention)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:length(tokens), labels = tokens) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(model_name, " - Layer ", layer, ", Head ", head),
      x = "Tokens",
      y = "",
      fill = "Attention"
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Use it:
plot_attention_density(olmo_data_stepmax, row_idx = 401)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)

# Function to clean Ġ symbols from tokens
clean_tokens <- function(tokens) {
  gsub("Ġ", "", tokens)
}

clean_tokens <- function(tokens) {
  gsub("ġ", "", tokens)
}

#================================================================================
#             DEFINE FUNCTION TO FIND TARGET TOKEN POSITIONS
#================================================================================
# Function to find token positions for a location string in a tokenized passage
find_token_positions <- function(tokenized_passage, location_string) {
  # Clean the Ġ symbols from the passage tokens
  passage_tokens <- clean_tokens(tolower(tokenized_passage))
  
  # Split location into tokens and clean/lowercase
  location_tokens <- strsplit(tolower(trimws(location_string)), "\\s+")[[1]]
  
  # Find all positions where the location appears
  positions <- list()
  
  if (length(location_tokens) == 1) {
    # Single token - find all matches
    positions <- which(passage_tokens == location_tokens[1])
  } else {
    # Multi-token - find sequences
    for (i in 1:(length(passage_tokens) - length(location_tokens) + 1)) {
      if (all(passage_tokens[i:(i + length(location_tokens) - 1)] == location_tokens)) {
        positions <- c(positions, i:(i + length(location_tokens) - 1))
      }
    }
    positions <- unlist(positions)
  }
  
  return(positions)
}

# Choose a dataframe to examine
df = olmo_data_stepmax

# Extract attention scores for start and end locations
df_with_location_attention <- df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # Find positions of start and end locations
    start_positions = list(find_token_positions(tokenized_passage, start)),
    end_positions = list(find_token_positions(tokenized_passage, end)),
    # Sum or mean attention over all matching positions
    attention_to_start = ifelse(length(start_positions) > 0,
                                mean(attention_scores[start_positions]),
                                NA_real_),
    attention_to_end = ifelse(length(end_positions) > 0,
                              mean(attention_scores[end_positions]),
                              NA_real_)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Now proceed with the analysis
#====================================
#      FILTER LOW-ENTROPY HEADS
#====================================
head_entropy <- df_with_location_attention %>%
  group_by(model_shorthand, step, layer, head) %>%
  summarize(mean_entropy = mean(entropy, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = 'drop')

low_entropy_threshold <- quantile(head_entropy$mean_entropy, 0.25)
low_entropy_heads <- head_entropy %>%
  filter(mean_entropy < low_entropy_threshold)

#============================================
# IDENTIFY HIGH ATTENTION FOR TARGET TOKENS
#============================================
df_filtered <- df_with_location_attention %>%
  semi_join(low_entropy_heads, by = c("model_shorthand", "step", "layer", "head")) %>%
  mutate(
    max_location_attention = pmax(attention_to_start, attention_to_end, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(max_location_attention))

#============================================
#      TEST FOR DIFFERENTIAL ATTENTION
#============================================
df_analysis <- df_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    correct_location_attention = ifelse(condition == "true_belief", 
                                        attention_to_end, 
                                        attention_to_start),
    incorrect_location_attention = ifelse(condition == "true_belief",
                                          attention_to_start,
                                          attention_to_end),
    attention_difference = correct_location_attention - incorrect_location_attention
  )

# 4. Statistical tests per head
head_condition_effects <- df_analysis %>%
  group_by(model_shorthand, step, layer, head) %>%
  summarize(
    n_observations = n(),
    mean_entropy = mean(entropy),
    
    # True belief: should attend more to END
    mean_attn_end_true = mean(attention_to_end[condition == "True Belief"], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_attn_start_true = mean(attention_to_start[condition == "True Belief"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # False belief: should attend more to START
    mean_attn_end_false = mean(attention_to_end[condition == "False Belief"], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_attn_start_false = mean(attention_to_start[condition == "False Belief"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Overall difference
    mean_diff_true_belief = mean(attention_difference[condition == "True Belief"], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_diff_false_belief = mean(attention_difference[condition == "False Belief"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Test if attention difference varies by condition
    p_value = if(n() > 10) tryCatch(
      t.test(attention_difference ~ condition)$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ) else NA_real_,
    
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_value)

# 5. Identify heads with significant differential attention
significant_heads <- head_condition_effects %>%
  filter(p_value < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    # Does this head track the correct location?
    tracks_correct = (mean_diff_true_belief > 0) & (mean_diff_false_belief < 0)
  )

print(significant_heads)

#============================================
#             VISUALIZE RESULTS
#============================================
library(ggplot2)

# Heatmap of attention patterns
ggplot(df_analysis, aes(x = condition, y = interaction(layer, head), 
                        fill = attention_difference)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", 
                       midpoint = 0) +
  labs(title = "Attention Difference: Correct - Incorrect Location",
       fill = "Attention\nDifference") +
  theme_minimal()


```
